questions.skill: 区分并行规定、直接冲突与领域排除
questions.q: A national law creates a comprehensive safety-label system for medical devices. A state adds a parallel labelling rule. A court invalidates the state provision because the national law has occupied the field. Which inference is strongest?
o: Resemblance to national rules is enough to void a state rule.
National coverage can bar a state rule without a direct clash.
The state rule conflicted with a neighbouring state's law.
The court found the national safety-label law lacked authority.

exp.trans: 国家法律建立了全面的医疗器械安全标签制度。某州又增加了一项并行的标签规定。法院因为国家法律已经全面覆盖该领域而判定州规定无效。最有力的推断是：即使没有直接矛盾，州规定也可能因领域排除而不能成立。
exp.structure: creates与adds分别描述国家和州制定规则；because引出法院判决的原因。because the national law has occupied the field不是说两项规则必须逐字冲突，而是说明该领域已由国家立法全面规制。
exp.other: comprehensive 全面的；labelling 标签规定；invalidate 判定无效；pre-empt 排除与之不相容的州层面规制。
exp.meaning: parallel只表示并行或相应，并不自动等于contradict。判断权限问题时，要区分直接冲突与国家立法已占据整个领域这两种理由。
exp.rest: 类似不自动等于无效，关键是国家立法已全面覆盖该领域；判决没有依据邻州法律；法院承认国家规范的权威，并未否定它。

questions.q: The city report listed its heritage museum alongside the public library as a valued institution. It said nothing about funding. What is supported by the report?
o: The library provided full funding for the museum.
The museum and library appeared in the same list.
The museum was run directly by library staff.
The library officially backed every museum plan.

exp.trans: 报告把博物馆和图书馆并列列为重要机构，未提资金来源。
exp.structure: listed A alongside B是并列列举；没有提供支持的谓语。
exp.other: heritage遗产；funding资金；back支持。
exp.meaning: alongside表示并列提及，不自动推出be backed by。
exp.rest: 资金、管理和全部计划的支持都擅自添加了原文未给出的关系。

questions.target: oppose process vs oppose all projects
questions.skill: 反对方式不等于反对建设
questions.q: A columnist says the city needs more clinics, but criticizes plans to build them without checking transport links or population needs. What is the columnist's position?
o: Every clinic proposal must be permanently rejected.
The clinics are needed, but their sites require scrutiny.
Residents should abandon all plans to expand care.
Transport capacity should never influence clinic sites.

exp.trans: 作者认可诊所需求，却批评不考虑交通与人口需求的选址。
exp.structure: needs more clinics肯定目标；but criticizes限定批评的方式。
exp.other: scrutiny审慎评估；transport links交通连接。
exp.meaning: 反对未经评估的选址不等于反对建设本身。
exp.rest: 全面否决、放弃扩建和无视交通都不符合作者立场。

questions.q:
一篇先分析家电过早报废、后提出改进办法的文章，有一候选段写道：After examining the figures, Dr Patel sums up her proposal: shared repair services could help residents keep appliances longer. 段末又说：Whether enough households will join, however, remains an open question.
这一段最适合放在哪里？
o: 全文开头，用来首次介绍Dr Patel
问题分析展开之前
全文结尾附近，作为总结和改革建议
只能放在具体数据段之前

exp.trans: 考察数据后，Patel博士总结自己的建议：共享维修服务或许能让居民更长久地使用电器。但是否有足够多家庭参与，仍是未决问题。这段最适合放在结尾附近。
exp.structure: After examining the figures回看前文数据；Dr Patel + sums up + her proposal明确给出总结动作。末句Whether...will join作主语，remains...为谓语部分，以未决问题收束。
exp.other: sum up 总结；shared repair service 共享维修服务；appliance 家电；household 家庭；open question 未决问题。
exp.meaning: 总结建议与回顾数据、开放结尾合起来支持尾段位置；单独出现concludes或sum up并不能证明必为全文最后一段。
exp.rest: 首次介绍人物不能解释已分析过数据；在问题分析前放总结建议与给定结构不合；“只能放在数据段之前”更与After examining the figures相反。

questions.q: A town councillor favored a new industrial site. Residents demanded an environmental review. The mayor proposed delaying approval, while a columnist backed the residents' request. Who favored the review?
o: The councillor and the industrial developer.
The mayor alone, rather than the residents.
The residents and the newspaper columnist.
All four parties, without any disagreement.

exp.trans: 议员支持工业用地，居民要求评估，市长建议延迟，作者支持居民。
exp.structure: councillor、residents、mayor、columnist对应不同动作。
exp.other: councillor议员；columnist专栏作者；review审查。
exp.meaning: 支持对象要逐一根据动词定位；延迟批准不必然等于支持评估。
exp.rest: 议员未赞成评估；市长没明确赞成；四方并不一致。

questions.skill: 区分报告数量变化与真实问题变化
questions.q: A clinic switched to an online incident form, after which recorded reports rose. External audits found no increase in underlying faults. Which conclusion is best supported?
o: The underlying fault rate rose because the clinic changed its form.
More recorded incidents may reflect easier reporting, not more faults.
External audits proved the old reporting system had been accurate.
The clinic changed the form after a separate review found fewer faults.

exp.trans: 诊所改用在线事件表单后，记录的报告增加了，但外部审计没有发现实际故障增加。记录数量的上升可能来自报告更容易，而不是故障变多。
exp.structure: A clinic switched...描述制度变化；after which引出其后的记录变化；External audits found...提供独立证据，限制对真实故障率的推断。
exp.other: incident form 事件报告表；recorded report 记录的报告；external audit 外部审计；underlying fault 实际故障。
exp.meaning: 观测到的报告数会受到报告渠道影响。记录数增加不能单独证明实际问题变多。
exp.rest: 表单变化本身不能证明故障率上升；审计没有证明旧系统完全准确；文中没有说改表单之前另一次审查发现故障减少。

questions.q: An archive memo says the old photographs need protection from damp air. It gives no account of whether protective equipment has been installed. What can be concluded?
o: The photographs require protection; current safeguards are unknown.
The photographs are already secured by effective equipment.
The photographs have all been irreversibly ruined by moisture.
The archive is planning to stop accepting photographs.

exp.trans: 备忘录提出防潮需求，但没有说明设备是否已安装。
exp.structure: need protection表达必要性；has been installed涉及完成状态，未知。
exp.other: damp潮湿的；safeguard防护措施；archive档案馆。
exp.meaning: 需要保护≠已经妥善保护，也不能断言此前完全没有防护。
exp.rest: 其他选项擅自确认保护成效、彻底毁损或停止接收。

questions.skill: 区分定语从句、宾语从句和主句谓语
questions.q: Engineers who noticed that the valve was leaking shut down the line. Which sequence gives the main-clause subject head / who-clause verb / main-clause verb?
o: Engineers / noticed / shut down
the valve / noticed / was leaking
Engineers / was leaking / noticed
the line / shut down / noticed

exp.trans: 注意到阀门漏液的工程师关闭了生产线。按题目要求的顺序，主句主语中心词是Engineers，who从句谓语是noticed，主句谓语是shut down。
exp.structure: 主句骨架是Engineers shut down the line；who noticed...修饰Engineers；that the valve was leaking是noticed的宾语从句。三个谓语分别属于不同层级。
exp.other: engineer 工程师；valve 阀门；leak 漏液；shut down 关闭、停运；subject head 主语中心词。
exp.meaning: 先找主句骨架，再把who定语从句和that宾语从句分别嵌入。阀门是that从句的主语，工程师才是主句主语。
exp.rest: the valve只在that从句中作主语；was leaking属于that宾语从句，不是who从句谓语；the line是shut down的宾语，不是主句主语。

text4-federal-state-boundary.target: parallel rule / occupied the field / field pre-emption
text4-federal-state-boundary.skill: 区分并行规则、直接冲突与领域排除
text4-federal-state-boundary.q: A national safety code covers the whole field of product labelling. A state adds a parallel rule, and a court invalidates it because the code has “occupied the field.” Which explanation best fits the ruling?
o: The rule failed because another state's policy directly contradicted it.
The rule was pre-empted because national law already covered the field.
The rule was approved because parallel rules can never conflict.
The court delayed the case until lawmakers revised the enforcement budget.

exp.trans: 国家安全规范全面覆盖了产品标签领域。某州又增加了一项并行规定，法院因为国家规范已经“占据了该领域”而判定州规定无效。最合适的解释是：国家法律已全面规制该领域，因此州规定被排除。
exp.structure: A national safety code covers the whole field；第二句由and连接州增加规定与法院判定无效的动作；because从句给出判决理由。occupied the field是法律语境中的领域排除概念。
exp.other: product labelling 产品标签；invalidate 判定无效；pre-empt 排除州层面的规制；enforcement budget 执法预算。
exp.meaning: parallel表示并行，不等于contradict。即使没有逐条直接冲突，若国家立法已经全面覆盖该领域，州规定仍可能被排除。
exp.rest: 另一州的政策不是本案依据；parallel rules can never conflict把并行绝对化；法院已经作出无效判决，并非等待预算调整。

text4-federal-state-boundary.skill: 区分并行规则、直接冲突与领域排除
text4-federal-state-boundary.q: A federal air-safety code exclusively regulates emergency signals. A city adopted a similar signal rule. Although the city's rule was not shown to contradict a specific clause, a court set it aside because the code already covered the entire field. Why?
o: The city rule was barred because national law already occupied the field.
The federal code was cancelled because the city's provisions ran parallel.
The court ordered the city to enforce its rule beside the national code.
The judges delayed a decision until the national agency reviewed its budget.

exp.trans: 一套联邦航空安全规范对紧急信号作了专属规定。某市采用了类似规则。尽管没有证明市级规则直接违反特定条文，法院仍因联邦规范已全面覆盖该领域而排除了市级规定。
exp.structure: Although引导让步：没有证明逐条直接矛盾；主句a court set it aside给出判决；because说明真正理由是整个领域已由上级规则全面规制。
exp.other: exclusively 专属地；signal 信号；contradict 与……相矛盾；set aside 废除、排除；occupy the field 通过全面规制排除下级立法。
exp.meaning: 并行或类似不等于相抵触；领域排除的判断依据是整个领域已由上级法律覆盖，不要求指出某条具体文字直接冲突。
exp.rest: 没有推翻联邦规范；法院没有命令城市同时执行两套规则；也没有推迟判决等待预算审查。

text4-federal-state-boundary.target: knock out / contested provisions / field preemption
text4-federal-state-boundary.skill: 法律词组放回语境 + 联邦与州权限边界
text4-federal-state-boundary.q: A legal report says the court 'knocked out' three contested provisions in a state's licensing plan. The judgment adds that the national legislature had already 'occupied the field,' although the state rules did not directly contradict one specific national clause. Which paraphrase best captures the reasoning?
o: The court delayed the dispute because the rules were too complicated.
The court struck down the rules because national law covered this field.
The court approved the rules as harmless additions to national policy.
The court found that the state had contradicted two other states' own laws.

exp.trans: 法院推翻了州计划中的争议条款，因为国家立法已经全面覆盖该领域。
exp.structure: knocked out表示推翻；contested provisions是有争议的条款；although引导让步，说明即使没有直接违反某一条具体规定，也可能因为occupied the field而被排除。
exp.other: knock out 推翻、使无效；contested 有争议的；provision 法律条款；occupy the field 全面覆盖某一立法领域。
exp.meaning: 判决的理由不是其他州的政策，也不是条款太复杂，而是国家立法已经全面规制该领域。parallel不自动等于contradict。
exp.rest: 延期审理与法院已经推翻条款不符；批准条款与invalidates相反；原文没有说州政策违反了另外两个州的法律。

familiar-word-polysemy.q: After approving two applications, the panel rejected the rest as unjust to smaller firms. In this sentence, the rest and unjust mean:
o: 休息 / 仅仅的
其余申请 / 不公正的
其余评委 / 刚刚发生的
暂停审批 / 合法的

exp.trans: 批准两份申请后，评审组以“对小企业不公平”为由拒绝了其余申请。the rest指剩下的申请；unjust表示不公正的。
exp.structure: the panel是主语，rejected是谓语，the rest是宾语；as unjust to smaller firms说明把其余申请视为何种性质。After approving...是时间背景。
exp.other: application 申请；panel 评审组；approve 批准；firm 企业。
exp.meaning: rest单独可表示休息，但the rest (of...)常表示“其余的”；just既可作副词“仅仅/刚刚”，也可作形容词“公正的”，unjust由后者加un-构成“不公正的”。
exp.rest: “休息 / 仅仅的”没有识别the rest所指的剩余申请，也误认了unjust的构词；“其余评委 / 刚刚发生的”把申请偷换成评委，且unjust不是副词just“刚刚”的否定；“暂停审批 / 合法的”既改变the rest的名词性含义，又把unjust的价值判断反转。

familiar-word-polysemy.target: dismiss A as B / address concerns
familiar-word-polysemy.skill: 熟词生义 + 固定搭配
familiar-word-polysemy.q: Officials first dismissed the complaint as trivial, but later had to address the evidence it contained. Which paraphrase is best?
o: 他们先解雇了投诉人，后来查找证据的地址。
他们起初把投诉斥为无足轻重，后来不得不处理其中的证据。
他们先证明投诉正确，后来决定忽视证据。
他们先将投诉寄出，后来改变了通信地址。

exp.trans: 官员们起初把这项投诉斥为无足轻重，但后来不得不处理其中包含的证据。
exp.structure: Officials是主语；dismissed是第一个谓语，the complaint是宾语，as trivial是宾补；but后had to address是第二个谓语结构，the evidence是宾语。
exp.other: complaint 投诉；trivial 微不足道的；evidence 证据；contain 包含。
exp.meaning: dismiss可表示“解雇”，但dismiss A as B是“把A斥为/视为B而不予重视”；address作动词可表示“处理、应对问题/担忧/证据”，不只表示地址。
exp.rest: “解雇投诉人、查找地址”把dismiss的宾语从投诉换成投诉人，并误用address的名词义；“先证明正确、后忽视证据”反转了dismiss与address在此处的意义；“寄出投诉、改变地址”虚构了邮寄行为和地址变化。

familiar-word-polysemy.q: Residents' anger over the water outage was justified: records showed that the utility had ignored repeated warnings before the pipes failed. Here justified means:
o: happening only a moment ago
expressed by an entirely impartial person
supported by adequate reasons
merely mentioned without emotion

exp.trans: 居民因停水而愤怒是有充分理由的：记录显示，自来水公司在水管故障前多次忽视警告。
exp.structure: Residents' anger是主语，was justified是系表/被动性质表达；冒号后records showed...为其理由提供证据。
exp.other: utility 公用事业公司；outage 中断；ignore warnings 忽视警告；adequate 充分的。
exp.meaning: justified通常表示有正当理由或充分依据，不应因为just也有‘仅仅’或‘公正的’就机械套进来。这里强调愤怒有依据，而不是愤怒这个情绪是否中立。
exp.rest: 刚刚发生对应just的副词用法而不是justified；完全中立并非愤怒有依据的条件；merely mentioned否定了原文的情绪与证据。

familiar-word-polysemy.q: The panel made a just decision, but the suspicion that its members had accepted bribes was not justified by the available evidence. Which distinction is correct?
o: The decision was recent; the evidence only referred to bribery.
The decision was fair; evidence did not support the suspicion.
The decision was unfair; evidence confirmed the bribery claim.
The decision expressed pride; the suspicion praised the panel.

exp.trans: 委员会作出了公正的决定，但现有证据不足以支持成员受贿的怀疑。just修饰决定时指公正；justified修饰怀疑时指是否有充分依据。
exp.structure: The panel + made + a just decision；but后the suspicion是主语，was not justified by...表示该怀疑缺乏证据支持；that从句解释怀疑的内容。
exp.other: panel 委员会；suspicion 怀疑；bribe 贿赂；available evidence 现有证据。
exp.meaning: just作为形容词可表示公正；justify动词表示证明合理/有正当理由；justified为有依据、可辩护的。它们语义相连但不能在句中任意互换。
exp.rest: recent和only误套just的其他词义；不公正且受贿已证实把两处意思都反转；pride和praise均不是这里just或justified的含义。

familiar-word-polysemy.q: At first, witnesses answered one question every ten minutes. Once the clerk combined repeated questions, the proceedings picked up pace. What changed?
o: The hearing moved through the questions faster.
The hearing switched to a more cautious schedule.
The clerk collected more questions for later use.
The witnesses were chosen at a more regular rate.

exp.trans: 起初证人每十分钟回答一题；书记员合并重复问题后，听证进程加快了。
exp.structure: Once引出时间条件；主句the proceedings是主语，picked up pace是谓语表达。速度变化属于听证进程，不属于挑选证人的频率。
exp.other: proceedings 会议或听证程序；clerk 书记员；witness 证人；pace 节奏、速度。
exp.meaning: pick up pace表示加快进程，要把pick up和pace作为整体理解，再结合减少重复问题的背景确认方向。
exp.rest: 更谨慎的日程不等于加速；收集问题把pick up误套到另一个宾语；挑选证人的频率把动作主体和对象都换掉了。

familiar-word-polysemy.q: After a week of poor sleep, her mental sharpness declined: she needed longer to notice mistakes in a familiar spreadsheet. What declined?
o: Her readiness to adopt a different working method.
Her willingness to persevere with a difficult task.
Her speed and accuracy in noticing relevant details.
Her freedom to choose which assignments to accept.

exp.trans: 一周睡眠不足后，她的思维敏锐度下降了：在熟悉的电子表格中发现错误也需要更久。
exp.structure: mental修饰sharpness；冒号后needed longer to notice mistakes解释这种能力下降的具体表现。
exp.other: sharpness 敏锐度；plasticity 可塑性；flexibility 灵活性；spreadsheet 电子表格。
exp.meaning: 敏锐度是及时捕捉、辨识信息的能力，不是可塑性、意志或选择自由。后文的表现帮助确定这个抽象名词的含义。
exp.rest: 采用新方法的意愿接近灵活性而非敏锐度；坚持意愿属于毅力；自主选择工作属于自由度，都不能解释发现熟悉表格中的错误变慢。

familiar-word-polysemy.q: The maker club receives projects of every sort. Before choosing a display, volunteers sort the entries by safety requirements, not by the money their owners can pay. Which reading of the two uses of sort is correct?
o: First: organise; second: a category of projects.
First: a category; second: arrange into groups.
First: select; second: the quality of projects.
First: a group; second: repair faulty projects.

exp.trans: 创客社团收到各种类型的项目。决定展示什么之前，志愿者按安全要求整理、分类这些参展项目，而不是按所有者能付多少钱。第一处sort是种类，第二处是进行分类。
exp.structure: of every sort中sort是介词of后的名词；第二句volunteers是主语，sort是谓语，the entries是宾语，by safety requirements说明分类依据。not by...排除另一标准。
exp.other: maker club创客社团；entry参展项目；display展示；requirement要求。
exp.meaning: 同一个熟词要根据句中位置判断词性。名词sort指种类，动词sort指分类、整理或筛选；这里不能让一种词性覆盖两处。
exp.rest: “先整理、后种类”将两处词性颠倒；“先选择、后项目质量”既把首处当动词又替换第二处含义；“先群体、后修理”没有体现of every sort的各类义，也把分类错成修复。

familiar-word-polysemy.skill: 抽象表达在具体决策中的作用
familiar-word-polysemy.q: A youth arts fund calls online popularity its 'sorting mechanism': acts with large followings get support, even if less visible groups show greater improvement. The writer questions the criterion, not the existence of different art forms. What does the expression refer to?
o: A building in which applications are kept on file.
A rule that prevents all public performances.
A criterion deciding which groups receive support.
A kind of performance that the fund itself buys.

exp.trans: 青年艺术基金把网络人气当作筛选机制：粉丝多的团队得到支持，即使曝光少的团队进步更大。作者质疑的是这种选择标准，而非艺术形式有不同种类这一事实。
exp.structure: 首句A youth arts fund为主语，calls为谓语，online popularity为宾语，its sorting mechanism为宾语补足语；冒号后用实际分配支持的做法解释该抽象词组。even if引出不改变结果的让步条件。
exp.other: act演出团队；following追随者群体；criterion标准；visible受关注的。
exp.meaning: sorting mechanism在这里指决定支持给谁的筛选、评价机制；理解抽象名词时，应找后文说明它如何运作的具体案例。
exp.rest: “存放申请的建筑”只抓到整理文件的表层联想；“禁止全部公共演出”加入并不存在的禁令；“基金购买的演出种类”把选择机制换成艺术类别。

familiar-word-polysemy.q: The minister delivered a sermon on forgiveness during the Sunday service. A sermon is:
o: a religious talk given to a congregation
a written list of payments due to a church
a private meeting to arrange a marriage
a short announcement about the weather

exp.trans: 牧师在周日礼拜期间发表了一篇关于宽恕的布道。sermon指布道、宗教讲道。
exp.structure: The minister是主语，delivered是谓语，a sermon是宾语；on forgiveness说明讲道主题，during the Sunday service说明时间场景。
exp.other: minister牧师；forgiveness宽恕；congregation会众；service礼拜。
exp.meaning: sermon通常指宗教场合面向会众的讲道，也可引申为带有训诫意味的长篇说教。
exp.rest: 教会应付款清单、安排婚姻的私人会议和天气公告都不符合minister、Sunday service及forgiveness共同构成的宗教语境。

familiar-word-polysemy.q: Workers were piling empty crates beside the loading bay before the delivery arrived. Piling means:
o: stacking them together in a heap
checking each one for a label
sending them to a distant warehouse
taking them apart for repair

exp.trans: 货物送达前，工人正在装卸区旁把空箱子堆起来。piling在此表示堆放、堆叠。
exp.structure: Workers是主语，were piling是过去进行时谓语，empty crates是宾语；beside the loading bay说明堆放地点。
exp.other: crate板条箱；loading bay装卸区；stack堆叠；delivery送货。
exp.meaning: pile可作动词，表示把物品堆成一堆；具体动作由宾语empty crates和地点beside the loading bay确定。
exp.rest: 检查标签、运往仓库和拆开维修都是其他操作，不能表达把箱子堆在一起。

familiar-word-polysemy.skill: 同一动词的具体与抽象语境
familiar-word-polysemy.q: After the booking website failed, complaints began piling up in the customer-service inbox. What does piling up mean here?
o: being deleted one by one
accumulating in increasing numbers
being answered before they arrived
being transferred to another company

exp.trans: 预约网站故障后，客服收件箱里的投诉开始不断累积。piling up在此表示数量越来越多。
exp.structure: complaints是主语，began piling up是谓语结构；in the customer-service inbox说明累积的位置。
exp.other: booking website预约网站；complaint投诉；accumulate累积；inbox收件箱。
exp.meaning: pile up既可指把实体物品堆叠起来，也可引申为问题、工作或投诉数量不断累积；这里不是把投诉作为实体搬动。
exp.rest: 删除、提前答复和转交给其他公司都不是数量持续增加的意思。

familiar-word-polysemy.q: At a fashion show, organizers extended the runway so models could walk farther in front of the audience. What did they change?
o: The catwalk used by models was made longer.
A strip for aircraft take-offs was added.
The standards for judging body shape were rewritten.
The audience seating was rearranged around the stage.

exp.trans: 时装秀主办方延长了runway，让模特能在观众面前走得更远。这里改变的是模特走秀的T台长度。
exp.structure: At a fashion show限定场景；organizers是主语，extended是谓语，the runway是宾语；so引导结果状语。
exp.other: runway在时装秀语境中是T台；catwalk走秀台；aircraft take-off飞机起飞；body shape体形。
exp.meaning: runway有机场跑道义，也有时装秀T台义。词义由fashion show、models和audience共同限定。原题中的错误选项抓住runways这一局部词形，却把时装展示语境改成机场基础设施。
exp.rest: 把T台换成飞机起降设施；把延长T台改成修改审美标准，改变了动作对象；改动观众席也与句中明确延长runway不符。

familiar-word-polysemy.skill: 抽象名词在评价语境中的含义
familiar-word-polysemy.q: At a national design competition, the jury served as the final arbiters of which proposals would receive the award. Here, arbiters are people who:
o: make the final decision about what is accepted
prepare the proposals for public display
provide funding to the designers on the shortlist
record the audience's reactions after the award

exp.trans: 在全国设计竞赛中，评审团是决定哪些方案获奖的最终裁定者。arbiters指作出最终判断的人。
exp.structure: the jury是主语，served as是谓语，the final arbiters是主语补足语；of which proposals说明裁定对象。
exp.other: arbiter裁定者、评判者；jury评审团；proposal提案；shortlist入围名单。
exp.meaning: arbiter强调有权作出判断或裁定的人，不是负责准备材料、提供资金或记录反馈的人。
exp.rest: 准备展品、提供资金和记录观众反应都是竞赛中的其他工作，不等于决定哪些方案获奖。

familiar-word-polysemy.q: A laboratory's early research prizes were overshadowed by a later safety scandal, but its published papers remained available. What happened to the prizes?
o: They were destroyed along with every research paper.
They received new awards for the later safety work.
Their significance was eclipsed by the scandal.
They were formally withdrawn by the entire team.

exp.trans: 实验室早年的研究奖项被安全丑闻盖过风头，但论文仍然存在。
exp.structure: were overshadowed是被动谓语；but限定论文依然存在。
exp.other: eclipsed使黯然失色；scandal丑闻；withdraw撤回。
exp.meaning: overshadow侧重重要性或影响被盖过，不等于实体摧毁。
exp.rest: 销毁、再获奖与正式撤回均是原文未确认的动作。

familiar-word-polysemy.q: During a school budget dispute, the teachers' union sided with parents pleading for smaller classes, although the board preferred a cheaper plan. Which position did the union take?
o: It supported the parents' request for smaller classes.
It endorsed the board's preferred cheaper proposal.
It asked the parents to stop making any requests.
It stayed neutral between parents and the board.

exp.trans: 工会支持呼吁缩小班级规模的家长，董事会则倾向更廉价的方案。
exp.structure: union是sided with主语；pleading for smaller classes修饰parents。
exp.other: side with支持某方；plead for呼吁；board董事会。
exp.meaning: side with明确支持对象，pleading for交代对方诉求。
exp.rest: 支持董事会、阻止诉求和保持中立都与支持家长相反。

familiar-word-polysemy.q: A research reserve forbade intrusion into nesting areas. The director later discontinued unrestricted vehicle access while keeping marked footpaths open. Which summary is accurate?
o: All visitors were permanently barred from the reserve.
The reserve stopped all forms of scientific research.
Vehicles were granted new access to nesting areas.
Unrestricted driving ended; footpaths stayed open.

exp.trans: 保护区禁止侵入筑巢区，终止无限制车辆通行，但步道继续开放。
exp.structure: discontinued宾语是unrestricted vehicle access；while表示另一安排依旧。
exp.other: intrusion侵入；discontinue停止；footpath步道。
exp.meaning: 停止某项政策不意味着全面关闭场所或终止全部活动。
exp.rest: 其余选项夸大停止范围，或颠倒了车辆通行状态。

author-stance.target: 事实描述 / 作者价值判断
author-stance.skill: 事实描述 ≠ 作者价值判断
author-stance.q: A report says that residents posted hundreds of angry comments after the council announced a parking plan. Which conclusion is directly supported?
o: The report endorses the angry comments as a fair response.
Residents posted many angry comments after the announcement.
The council designed the plan knowing it would harm residents.
The comments show that opposition extended to every resident.

exp.trans: 一份报告说，市议会公布停车方案后，居民发布了数百条愤怒评论。原文直接支持：居民在公告后发布了大量愤怒评论；after只说明先后，不能据此确定因果。
exp.structure: 主句：A report（主语）+ says（谓语）+ that宾语从句。that从句：residents（主语）+ posted（谓语）+ hundreds of angry comments（宾语）；after从句只交代时间。句子报告发生了什么，没有评价这些评论是否应得。
exp.other: council 市议会；announce 公布；substantial 大量的/显著的；reaction 反应。
exp.meaning: 负面评论的存在不等于作者认为批评对象活该。after只报告时间先后；要断言公告引发评论，还需要明确的因果证据。
exp.rest: 报告评论数量不等于赞同评论；设计有害方案的动机没有证据；数百条评论不能扩大为每一位居民的立场。

author-stance.target: 引述立场 / 作者限定评价
author-stance.skill: 事实描述 ≠ 作者价值判断
author-stance.q: An association calls volunteers “unreliable.” The author notes that missed visits often follow last-minute roster changes. “Better coordination,” she writes, “would be more useful than another lecture about commitment.” Which view belongs to the author?
o: She accepts the association’s description as an explanation for the missed visits.
She regards missed visits as evidence that volunteers want to leave.
She favours improving coordination over simply blaming commitment.
She considers punctuality irrelevant to the association’s work.

exp.trans: 某协会把志愿者称为“不可靠”。作者指出，缺席往往发生在排班临时变动之后。她写道：“更好的协调，比再说教一遍奉献精神更有用。”作者倾向改善协调，而不是简单归咎于态度。
exp.structure: An association + calls + volunteers + unreliable属于引述他人评价。The author + notes + that从句另给解释线索；would be more useful than是作者自己的比较判断，she writes确定说话者。
exp.other: association 协会；roster 排班表；last-minute 临时的；commitment 投入、责任心。
exp.meaning: 先分清谁在评价，再追踪作者自己的证据和限定比较。这里没有deserve或all，也不能把文章引用的标签直接记到作者名下。
exp.rest: accepts the description把协会标签当作者解释，忽略作者提供的排班因素；want to leave补出离开的动机；punctuality irrelevant把“协调更有用”扩大成准时无关，比较优先级不等于否认准时的重要性。

author-stance.q: An editorial says: "Opening the reading room on Sundays deserves a trial. The report offered to justify it, however, omits staff costs and cannot establish that the plan is affordable." How does the editorial assess the report?
o: It is inadequate as a case for the proposal.
It convincingly establishes the project's value.
It merely lists facts without supporting a view.
It gives a fair account of all financial effects.

exp.trans: 社论认为周日开放阅览室值得试行；但作为论据的报告漏计人力成本，无法证明方案负担得起。对报告的判断是论证不足。
exp.structure: Opening...是首句主语；第二句The report是主语，omits与cannot establish是并列谓语。however把值得尝试的方案与不足以支撑它的报告区分开。
exp.other: editorial 社论；justify 为……提供理由；omit 漏计；affordable 负担得起的。
exp.meaning: 问评价时先确定对象。对方案的局部肯定不能代替对报告证据质量的否定评价。
exp.rest: “有力证明项目价值”与cannot establish相反；报告被用来论证方案，不能说不支持任何观点；漏计人力成本使其并未完整涵盖财务影响。

author-stance.q: An editorial welcomes new electricity lines where grid demand is high, but warns against allowing contractors to cut through protected habitats without review. Which position is most faithful?
o: Electricity networks should never expand anywhere.
Protected habitats should be opened to any contractor.
Expansion is acceptable when routes are carefully reviewed.
New electricity lines are unnecessary in busy regions.

exp.trans: 社论欢迎在需求高处增设电线，却反对未经审查穿越保护区。
exp.structure: welcomes...where...限制支持范围；but warns against说明反对对象。
exp.other: grid电网；contractor承包商；habitat栖息地。
exp.meaning: 可以支持有规划的扩建，同时反对任意侵占。
exp.rest: 完全禁止扩建、允许随意穿越和否认需求都偏离作者立场。

author-stance.skill: 明确反对对象与替代方案
author-stance.q: A planner argues that housing is necessary, yet proposes reusing vacant city lots before converting farmland. She criticizes unchecked edge-of-town building. What is her main objection?
o: She objects to every form of new housing.
She believes vacant city lots should stay unused.
She opposes protecting farmland near urban areas.
She objects to poorly sited growth, not all housing.

exp.trans: 规划师承认住房需求，优先用城市空地，反对无控制的郊外扩建。
exp.structure: housing is necessary肯定目标；yet提出选址优先顺序。
exp.other: vacant lot闲置地；farmland农田；unchecked未经控制的。
exp.meaning: 反对不合理选址不等于反对住房供给。
exp.rest: 完全禁止、让城市空地闲置和反对保护农田都与原文相反。

paragraph-order-discourse.q:
段落甲结尾：Not surprisingly, nearly half of the applicants withdraw before the final interview.
下面哪个段首与它的衔接最强？
o: Equally unsurprisingly, few of the remaining applicants receive an offer.
By contrast, the final interviews take place in the company's new building.
For example, managers from several departments attend the final interview.
In conclusion, a final interview is unnecessary for applicants who remain.

exp.trans: 甲段说“不出所料，近一半申请者在终面前退出”。最强衔接是：“同样不足为奇的是，留下的人中也只有很少一部分收到录用。”
exp.structure: Not surprisingly先给出一个“并不意外”的结果；Equally unsurprisingly显式要求前面已经有一个同类判断，再补第二个并列结果。两个副词短语构成明显篇章钩子。
exp.other: withdraw 退出；final interview 终面；a small share 少部分；receive an offer 获得录用。
exp.meaning: Equally / similarly / also 等段首词常要求前文存在可并列对象。排序题中这种平行措辞比泛泛的主题相似更可靠。
exp.rest: 换到面试地点没有形成真正对立；经理参会不是申请者退出的例子；也不能从退出比例推出剩余申请者无需面试。平行标记与申请者筛选链共同支持承接。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 段尾问题 / 原因解释
paragraph-order-discourse.q:
前段：The theatre sold every seat at the advertised price. Yet the deposits in its bank account were smaller than the value of tickets sold. The manager began tracing the gap between bookings and payments.
哪个后段最能推进这一问题？
o: Audience surveys ranked music above scenery when asking about favourite parts of the performance.
The booking agency deducted its service fees before forwarding the remaining money to the theatre.
The theatre had used the same stage for years, although its audience changed with each production.
Rehearsals ended later than planned, so actors sometimes travelled home together.

exp.trans: 剧院按宣传价卖出了所有座位，但银行入账小于售票总额。经理追查订票与收到款项之间的差额。订票代理转款之前先扣除服务费，最直接解释这个差额。
exp.structure: The theatre + sold + every seat。deposits + were smaller than + the value of tickets sold是金额比较。正确后段中The booking agency + deducted + service fees；before forwarding说明扣款发生在剧院收到钱之前。
exp.other: deposit 入账款；advertised price 宣传价格；deduct 扣除；forward money 转款。
exp.meaning: 没有One reason或Equally等显眼连接词，也能由段尾的收款差额锁定后段的扣费机制。这是问题→原因，不是看见theatre或audience就接同主题段。证据来自金额和交易阶段，不是一个单词。
exp.rest: Audience surveys解释演出偏好，未说明钱款差额；same stage介绍场地历史，未接收款链；rehearsals和共同回家是演出活动信息，不解释代理转款前少了什么。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 表面便利 vs 参与不足
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 讽刺语气 + 对比过渡
paragraph-order-discourse.q:
前文：The online course called itself interactive, but students could do little more than click Next after each recorded lecture. The easiest part was operating the screen; the hardest was staying awake.
【空缺】
后文：What would genuine participation require? Students could challenge arguments and revise one another's work.
哪句最适合？
o: The simple controls already give learners an active role in shaping the course.
A redesign could replace passive viewing with a real role in shaping discussion.
Recorded lectures also let learners choose when to watch the same presentation.
Adding subtitles would make the recorded lectures easier for learners to follow.

exp.trans: 前文用带讽刺性的说法指出所谓互动课仍只让学生被动点下一页；正确句转向让学生真正贡献观点的另一种课程；后文追问真正参与需要什么。
exp.structure: but建立宣称interactive与实际只能click Next的矛盾；the hardest was staying awake暗示被动乏味。正确句用replace passive viewing with a real role in shaping discussion提出另一模式，后文再具体说明质疑论点与互相修改。
exp.other: interactive 互动的；lecture 讲座/课；challenge an argument 质疑论点；revise 修订。
exp.meaning: 看到操作很简单，不能自动判为作者赞扬。应结合转折、夸张和后文提问判断作者真正评价：被动消费不足，主动参与才是重点。
exp.rest: 操作简单不等于能参与建构讨论；自选观看时间和字幕提升观看便利，却没有补上后文要求的质疑论点、互评修改等主动参与。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 单向展示→反向参与→后文设问
paragraph-order-discourse.q:
前文：At the old science museum, visitors watched a machine demonstrate each experiment. The most demanding thing they could do was press the Start button.
【空缺】
后文：What counts as taking part in an experiment? Visitors must be able to change a variable and compare the results.
哪一句最适合？
o: Repairs to the building could give the passive displays a more attractive setting.
Simpler controls could help more visitors watch the same machine demonstrations.
More detailed labels could explain the inventors behind the museum's machines.
A redesign could replace watching demonstrations with carrying out one's own tests.

exp.trans: 旧科技馆由机器单向演示，观众几乎只能按开始按钮。正确句引出新展览如何扭转这种被动观看，让观众亲自试验；后文再问什么才是真正参与实验。
exp.structure: 前文visitors watched与could do ... press Start显示参与程度低；正确句replace watching demonstrations with carrying out one’s own tests对比观看与亲自实验，后文change a variable和compare the results说明这种参与如何实现。
exp.other: demanding 费力的；demonstration 演示；variable 变量；carry out a test 进行试验。
exp.meaning: 最有力的证据是双向：反转被动的安排承接前文，主动测试又引出后文讨论。‘最难任务只是按按钮’在语境中揭示参与不足，不是对设备的夸赞。
exp.rest: 场馆外观、观看操作和发明者标签仍把参观者放在观看或接收信息的位置；只有亲自测试自然引出后文改变变量、比较结果的参与标准。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: new funding mechanism / That consequence / topical two-group distractor
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 制度改革先说明执行机制，再由That引出合作结果
paragraph-order-discourse.q: A public library will stop funding children's and adult literacy programs through entirely separate budgets. Officials stress that the reform should strengthen both. [BLANK] That should produce more projects serving whole families, rather than two unrelated groups. Which fits?
o: The new process will require both programs to design projects together.
Regional libraries have published more reports about literacy this year.
Some employees focus on adult readers, while others teach children.
The board will create separate committees for each age group.

exp.trans: 图书馆计划取消儿童和成人识字项目完全分立的预算。改革目标是同时加强两者。随后要解释两项目如何一起设计方案，这才能使服务整个家庭的合作项目增加。
exp.structure: That回指空格中描述的具体做法；new process...design projects together才会自然导致projects serving whole families。两个研究群体的存在是话题背景，不是合作机制。
exp.other: literacy 读写能力；entirely separate 完全分开的；joint project 联合项目；committee 委员会。
exp.meaning: topic match≠discourse link：后句That should produce...是结果句，前句需要明确的行动或机制。如果只描述两个群体，读起来相关却没有形成因果链。
exp.rest: 发表报告不一定促进合作；成人/儿童分工只描述现状；继续成立独立委员会甚至背离整合改革的目标。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: policy integration / mechanism / This change consequence
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 空前改革目标与空后合作效果需要中间实施步骤
paragraph-order-discourse.q: A museum plans to replace isolated conservation and education grants with a shared application process. Its directors say neither department will lose support. [BLANK] This change could generate exhibitions linking research and visitor experience. Which fits?
o: The museum has recently seen a sharp increase in visitor attendance.
Staff will evaluate proposals jointly and choose teams to collaborate.
The departments have long published very different research reports.
The museum will divide each grant into two fixed independent parts.

exp.trans: 博物馆将把保护和教育研究的独立资助改成联合申请。管理层说两部门都不会失去支持。空格要解释联合评审并选择合作团队，才能顺接‘这一变化会产生连接研究与观众体验的展览’。
exp.structure: 空格前提供改革背景和意图；This change could generate...给出预期效果。中间需要能产生该效果的具体协作措施，而非笼统主题描述。
exp.other: conservation 保护、文物修复；grant 资助；jointly 联合地；exhibition 展览。
exp.meaning: 要核实桥接是否构成‘政策→机制→结果’链条，不能因选项也谈博物馆或部门就草率接受。
exp.rest: 游客增加和以往报告差异只是主题信息；再把资金硬分成两部分反而违背联合申请改革。

paragraph-order-discourse.q: An energy guide first explains that meter logs locate periods of high demand. A paragraph about equipment inspections follows. The next two paragraphs describe a bakery and a warehouse that combined logs with inspections. What is the role of the inspections paragraph?
o: It completes the methods that the later cases apply.
It summarizes the outcomes reported in the later cases.
It gives a third case after the bakery and warehouse.
It withdraws the claim that meter logs can be useful.

exp.trans: 能源指南先解释用电表日志定位高需求时段，再介绍设备检查；后面两个案例同时使用日志和检查。检查段是在补齐随后案例会应用的方法。
exp.structure: first、follows、next交代段落顺序；combined logs with inspections说明两个案例同时依赖前面两种方法，不是只应用第一段的方法。
exp.other: meter log 电表记录；equipment inspection 设备检查；high demand 高需求；apply 应用。
exp.meaning: 一个方法段结束，不代表下一段必须马上举例。要检查后面案例需要哪些方法说明，再分清并列方法与两则应用案例的层级。
exp.rest: 总结后文结果需要结果性内容，检查方法本身不能当作结果总结；它位于两案例前也不是第三案例；案例同时使用日志，并未撤回日志有用的判断。

attribution-stance.target: 作者引用专家 / 报道对象
attribution-stance.skill: 引述主张与作者的使用
attribution-stance.q: A journalist reports marine biologists' view that a river survey will reveal whether young fish can pass an old dam. She then criticizes the operator for delaying access to sampling sites but does not dispute the biologists' description of the survey. What does the article present as the survey's purpose?
o: To determine whether young fish can travel past the dam.
To calculate the operator's annual advertising spending.
To prove the journalist agrees with every biologist's opinion.
To establish that delaying site access was legal.

exp.trans: 记者转述海洋生物学家观点：河流调查将查明幼鱼能否通过旧水坝；随后她批评运营方拖延提供取样点通行，但没有否认调查目的。因此文章呈现的调查目标仍是鱼类通行情况。
exp.structure: A journalist reports [biologists' view that...]；that从句的whether内容指明survey要查明什么。then后作者对运营方的批评是另一个命题。
exp.other: marine biologist 海洋生物学家；dam 水坝；sampling site 取样点；dispute 质疑、反驳。
exp.meaning: in the author's account可以包括作者引用并作为论述背景的专家描述，但这不等于作者无条件赞同专家所有观点。要分辨所引述的事件内容与作者额外的评价。
exp.rest: 广告开支和访问是否合法不是调查问题；‘同意每一项观点’超出文本证据，不能从引用且未反驳推出。

attribution-stance.target: 转述观点 / 作者保留态度
attribution-stance.skill: 没有反驳不等于完全赞同
attribution-stance.q: A columnist quotes a consultant who claims that closing the library on Sundays will save substantial money. The columnist adds that no cost figures have been released to support this prediction. Which description of the columnist's position is best?
o: The columnist finds the savings claim insufficiently supported.
The columnist has independently verified large savings.
The columnist proves Sunday closure cannot save any money.
The columnist discusses only the consultant's personal character.

exp.trans: 专栏作者引用顾问的说法：图书馆周日闭馆能省下不少钱；但作者指出没有公开成本数据支持这一预测。作者报道了这个说法，同时保留对其依据的质疑。
exp.structure: A columnist + quotes + a consultant who claims...；后句The columnist + adds + that从句，说明作者自己的保留意见。that no cost figures...不是顾问的立场。
exp.other: consultant 顾问；substantial 大量的；prediction 预测；verify 核实。
exp.meaning: 分清‘别人说了什么’和‘作者如何评价别人说法’。引用不是自动背书；提出证据不足，也不是凭空证明相反结论必然成立。
exp.rest: 独立验证节省金额与no cost figures矛盾；绝不省钱是相反的过强断言；作者讨论了预测和证据，并非只评价个人品格。

attribution-stance.target: 正式结论 / 作者评价
attribution-stance.q: A race panel restored a runner's result because no rule allowed exclusion on a single faulty sensor reading. A columnist accepts that decision but notes that the runner's account of his route clashes with two camera records. Which view belongs to the columnist?
o: The official result must be cancelled immediately.
The runner's account is not entirely persuasive.
The panel has proved the runner told the truth.
The camera records are too trivial to consider.

exp.trans: 比赛裁判组恢复了一名选手的成绩，因为规则不允许只凭一次有问题的传感器读数取消资格。评论者接受这一决定，但指出选手对路线的叙述与两处影像记录不符。因此，评论者对叙述的可信度有保留。
exp.structure: 首句race panel是决定的主体，because从句说明规则依据；第二句columnist是accepts和notes的共同主语，but把接受正式结果与质疑叙述分开。which view要求匹配后者的评价。
exp.other: panel裁判组；exclusion取消资格；faulty有问题的；clash with与……冲突。
exp.meaning: 正式处理结果与叙述是否可信是两个判断。作者可以接受前者，同时质疑后者；不能因此替作者增加撤销成绩或已经证明说谎等结论。
exp.rest: “必须立即取消成绩”与accepts that decision不符；“裁判组证明选手说真话”将证据不足以取消资格扩大为事实证明；“影像记录太琐碎”颠倒了评论者用它提出疑问的作用。

attribution-stance.target: 人物观点 / 道德评价
attribution-stance.q: A school committee says a garden project met its minimum reporting rules. In an editorial, a teacher writes that the organiser never asked why some children were left out: 'A completed form is no substitute for taking responsibility.' Which view is the teacher expressing?
o: The school needs a new national inspection agency.
Every excluded child must have broken school rules.
Formal compliance does not settle the ethical concern.
The committee found that no children were excluded.

exp.trans: 校方委员会说花园项目达到了最低报告要求。教师在社论中指出，组织者从没追问某些孩子为何被排除，并说填完表格不能代替承担责任。教师强调，形式合规尚未解决道德责任问题。
exp.structure: 首句school committee转述形式规则方面的判断；第二句a teacher writes引出教师评价，that从句记录组织者遗漏的追问。引语中A completed form是主语，is no substitute for...是否定性的表语结构。
exp.other: committee委员会；leave out排除；compliance合规；ethical道德上的。
exp.meaning: 通过具体的未追问案例，作者把关注点从完成手续转向组织者责任。提到规则，并不等于作者一定主张另设监管机构。
exp.rest: “需要新国家级检查机构”是额外政策推断；“每个被排除的孩子都违规”没有证据；“无人被排除”与some children were left out直接矛盾。

attribution-stance.target: public opinion vs parties vs writer
attribution-stance.q: A transport survey found strong support for cleaner buses. Party A opposed funding them, Party B stayed silent, and a columnist called the plan sensible but poorly funded. Which interpretation fits?
o: The public favors buses, while party responses differ.
Party B has publicly endorsed the full funding plan.
The columnist agrees that the buses are unnecessary.
Party A shares the survey respondents' enthusiasm.

exp.trans: 公众支持清洁公交，A党反对出资、B党沉默，作者认为方案合理但经费不足。
exp.structure: survey、Party A、Party B、columnist分别是不同意见来源。
exp.other: survey民调；funding资金；endorse支持。
exp.meaning: 公众态度、政党行动与作者评价不能混为一个立场。
exp.rest: 沉默不等于支持；作者未否认必要性；该政党未附和民意。

example-claim-scope.target: 具体反对行动支持哪条主旨
example-claim-scope.skill: 例子→论点 / 不能多推态度变化
example-claim-scope.q: A city report says proposals to digitize building permits have repeatedly stalled because established interests resist change. It cites a builders' association that organized petitions and delayed the new system for six months. What does the example mainly illustrate?
o: Organized groups can impede administrative reforms.
The association persuaded every resident to change political allegiance.
Most builders oppose the current political system in all circumstances.
Digital permits always cost more than paper applications.

exp.trans: 城市报告说，建筑许可数字化改革屡次被既有利益团体阻挠，并举建筑协会组织请愿、使新系统推迟六个月的例子。例子说明利益团体可能阻碍行政改革。
exp.structure: 主句proposals ... have stalled because...提出上层论点；It cites an association ...是作为证据的例子；organized petitions / delayed是例子中的行为与结果。
exp.other: digitize 数字化；permit 许可证；established interests 既有利益集团；administrative reform 行政改革。
exp.meaning: 例证题先找例子附近作者要证明的论点：改革遭遇阻力。组织请愿不等于改变公众政治立场；反对一项改革也不等于反对整个政治制度。
exp.rest: 政治归属改变需要前后态度证据；所有情况下反对现行政治制度扩大对象与频率；数字许可成本并未涉及。

example-claim-scope.target: 例子与论点的对应范围
example-claim-scope.skill: 不能靠团体行动推固定结论
example-claim-scope.q: An article argues that locally organized groups can sometimes help an unpopular policy get started. It describes a farmers' cooperative that trained volunteers and persuaded members to test a water-saving system, helping the trial begin on schedule. What is the role of this example?
o: It measures a shift in members' views on conservation.
It shows why government funds were needed for the trial.
It explains how the new system reduced water consumption.
It illustrates how local groups can help launch a policy.

exp.trans: 文章认为地方组织有时能帮助不受欢迎的政策启动，随后举农民合作社培训志愿者、推动成员试用节水系统，使试验按时开展的例子。这个例子是在支持‘团体也能帮助政策落实’。
exp.structure: An article argues + that从句是主张；It describes...引出实例；helping the trial begin是实例中的实际结果。
exp.other: cooperative 合作社；facilitate 促进；implementation 落实；trial 试行。
exp.meaning: 例子支持的结论可以是促进改革，也可以是阻碍改革，取决于前后文。不要机械地把‘团体动员’与‘妨碍改革’绑定。
exp.rest: 没有成员前后态度的测量，不能证明观点转变；材料没有交代政府资金；也没有比较节水系统的技术效果。合作社组织志愿者和动员试用，支持的是政策启动机制。

example-claim-scope.skill: 识别反例对充分条件的限制而非扩大成全面否定
example-claim-scope.q: A consultant argues that longer opening hours are enough to widen access to museums. A writer responds with a neighbourhood museum that stayed open until 10 p.m., yet attracted few additional night-shift workers. Interviews revealed that the last bus serving their workplaces left at 8 p.m. Why does the writer include this case?
o: To show that transport constraints can limit what extended hours achieve.
To identify reduced bus services as a consequence of the later museum hours.
To compare tourists' reasons for visiting with those of local residents.
To present later opening as a substitute for improving transport links.

exp.trans: 顾问认为，只要延长开放时间，就足以让更多人有机会参观博物馆。作者回应说，一家社区博物馆开放到晚上十点，却几乎没有多吸引夜班工人。访谈发现，途经他们工作地点的末班公交在晚上八点就开走了。作者为何举这个例子？为了说明交通限制会影响延长开放时间的实际效果。
exp.structure: A consultant + argues + that从句提出待检验的充分条件；A writer + responds with + a museum引出反例。that stayed open...为修饰museum的定语从句；yet转向预期未实现的结果；Interviews + revealed + that从句提供限制条件。
exp.other: widen access 扩大参与机会；neighbourhood 社区；night-shift worker 夜班工人；extended hours 延长的开放时间；transport link 交通连接。
exp.meaning: 例子针对的是延长开放时间是否单独就足够。公交仍是障碍，说明措施的效果受另一条件限制；没有证明延时开放普遍无效，也没有比较不同群体的喜好。
exp.rest: 末班车时间是已有约束，文中没有说公交服务因博物馆延时而削减；游客与本地居民的参观动机没有被比较；例子指出仅延时仍不足，不能反说延时可以替代交通改善。

example-claim-scope.skill: 把实例放回可见记录与实际行为的区分
example-claim-scope.q: An essay distinguishes a visible change in records from a change in underlying behaviour. It describes a factory where reported near-misses increased after a safety bonus was introduced. An anonymous survey found no change in how often hazards occurred; workers said they had previously kept quiet about them. What does the case illustrate?
o: The bonus increased hazards along with reports of near-misses.
Official incident totals are more reliable than the survey.
Anonymity motivated workers more than the safety bonus did.
Reporting changes can raise counts without raising hazards.

exp.trans: 文章区分记录上的可见变化与实际行为的变化。文中举例，一家工厂引入安全奖励后，上报的险情增多。匿名调查发现，危险出现的频率并没有变化；工人说自己以前对这些情况保持沉默。这个例子说明，记录数量上升可能源自上报方式改变，而不意味着危险同步增加。
exp.structure: An essay + distinguishes + A from B提出上层区分；It + describes + a factory引出例子，where从句补充上报数量变化。was introduced是被动谓语。An anonymous survey + found + no change；how often hazards occurred补充频率。had previously kept quiet指出早期漏报背景。
exp.other: near-miss 险些发生的事故、险情；underlying 实际的、深层的；anonymous 匿名的；hazard 危险因素；incident total 事件总数。
exp.meaning: 实例在支持记录变化不等于实际事件变化这一论点。新增上报与此前沉默形成对照，不能把记录增多直接推成工作更危险；也不应把例证题改答成未讨论的奖励与匿名措施孰强。
exp.rest: 调查显示危险发生频率未变，不能断言奖励增加危险；材料没有给两种数据排可靠性名次；匿名是调查方式，不能据此比较匿名与奖金的激励强度。

example-claim-scope.skill: 区分记录数量变化与真实风险变化
example-claim-scope.q: After a factory introduced anonymous reporting, recorded safety events rose. Independent inspections found no increase in hazards. Which conclusion is best supported?
o: The factory became more dangerous after anonymous reporting was introduced.
The rise in reports proves workers deliberately exaggerated safety incidents.
The higher event count may reflect reporting changes rather than more hazards.
Independent inspections confirmed that hazards increased throughout the factory.

exp.trans: 工厂引入匿名报告后，记录到的安全事件增加了，但独立检查没有发现危险因素增加。最有根据的结论是：记录数量的上升可能来自报告方式的变化，而非真实危险增加。
exp.structure: After引导时间背景；recorded safety events rose描述记录数；Independent inspections found no increase in hazards提供独立证据，限制了对真实风险的推断。
exp.other: anonymous reporting 匿名报告；recorded event 记录到的事件；independent inspection 独立检查；hazard 危险因素。
exp.meaning: 报告数量是观测到的数据，可能受报告机制影响；不能直接把记录数增加等同于真实危险增加。
exp.rest: 直接断言工厂更危险，与独立检查结果不符；把报告增加归因于故意夸大，原文没有动机证据；把检查结果说反了。

modal-stage.target: is trying to establish / would be introduced
modal-stage.q: An engineering association is trying to establish voluntary safety standards for battery repairs. Its report says common standards would be introduced if enough workshops joined the pilot. Which interpretation is supported?
o: The standards are being pursued, but are not yet in force.
The standards are already operating in every workshop.
The association has stopped pursuing the proposed standards.
The workshops finished drafting the standards before the pilot.

exp.trans: 一个工程协会正在尝试为电池维修制定自愿性安全标准。报告说，如果有足够多的维修点参加试点，就会引入统一标准。
exp.structure: is trying to establish是现在进行时，表示当前正在尝试；would be introduced是情态动词加被动语态，if从句给出条件。
exp.other: voluntary自愿的；standard标准；pilot试点；in force生效。
exp.meaning: is trying to establish说明制定工作正在推进；would be introduced说明预期/条件下将引入，并不表示已经完成。必须区分尝试、预期结果和已经生效。
exp.rest: 把预期结果升级成已经在所有维修点生效；把正在推进改成停止；把标准完成时间倒置到试点开始之前。

modal-stage.target: would be adopted if / 条件结果
modal-stage.skill: 条件性将来与完成状态
modal-stage.q: After a trial, a hospital report says a shared handover checklist would be adopted if staff approved the plan. Which statement is accurate?
o: The checklist is already used across every hospital ward.
Adoption depends on staff approval and is not yet complete.
The hospital cancelled the checklist after the trial.
Staff approved the checklist before the plan was first proposed.

exp.trans: 试点结束后，医院报告说，如果员工批准方案，就会采用统一的交接清单。是否采用仍取决于员工批准，并非已经完成。
exp.structure: would be adopted是情态动词加被动结构；if staff approved the plan是条件从句。
exp.other: handover交接；checklist清单；adopt采用；approval批准。
exp.meaning: would be adopted if...表示条件满足时预期采用，不能据此说已经在所有病区使用。
exp.rest: 把条件性计划说成全面实施；把医院取消方案当成原文事实；把员工批准提前到方案提出之前。

modal-stage.q: A marine reserve restored coral beds ten years ago. Now repeated heatwaves damage new sections every summer, and scientists call for continued monitoring. Which description best follows the timeline?
o: The reserve never achieved any restoration in the past.
The reef is now fully protected and no longer at risk.
The coral beds were already completely destroyed years ago.
Past restoration succeeded, but new damage continues.

exp.trans: 十年前恢复珊瑚，如今热浪每年损伤新区域，科学家要求监测。
exp.structure: restored与Now...every summer构成过去成果与持续威胁。
exp.other: coral珊瑚；heatwave热浪；monitoring监测。
exp.meaning: 过去成功不等于现在安全，持续损伤不等于全部毁灭。
exp.rest: 其余选项否认历史成果、夸大保护或虚构彻底毁灭。

modal-stage.q: After a cyberattack, a hospital report states that its network needs stronger access controls. A proposal has been drafted, but no installation date is recorded. Which claim is warranted?
o: The new controls have already been fully deployed.
Stronger controls are recommended, not confirmed in place.
Every hospital computer has been permanently disabled.
The attack proved all past network controls were useless.

exp.trans: 医院提出加强网络权限控制，有草案但没有部署日期。
exp.structure: needs表达需要；has been drafted只确认方案草案形成。
exp.other: deploy部署；access control访问控制。
exp.meaning: 建议加强不等于完成部署，攻击也不能证明全部过去措施无效。
exp.rest: 其他选项无依据地声称完成部署、全部瘫痪或旧控制全无用。

nested.skill: who 定语从句 + that 宾语从句 + 主句谓语
nested.target: who 定语从句 / that 宾语从句
nested.q:
Applicants who believe that a longer résumé automatically proves greater ability often overlook the value of relevance.
哪组句法判断正确？
o: 主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 overlook
主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 proves；主句谓语 believe
主句主语 a longer résumé；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 overlook
主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 proves

diag.1: proves 属于 that 宾语从句，不是 who 从句的核心谓语；believe 也不是主句谓语。
diag.2: a longer résumé 是 that 从句内部的主语，不是整句主语。
diag.3: proves 是 that 从句谓语；整句主句谓语是 overlook。

exp.trans: 那些认为简历越长就自然能证明能力越强的申请者，往往忽视了“相关性”的价值。
exp.structure: 原始简单句① Applicants often overlook the value of relevance. ② Applicants believe something. ③ A longer résumé automatically proves greater ability. → ②把 something 换成 that 从句：Applicants believe that... → 再把②变成修饰 Applicants 的 who 定语从句：Applicants who believe that... often overlook...。所以整句主语 Applicants，who 从句谓语 believe，that 从句谓语 proves，主句谓语 overlook。
exp.other: applicant 申请者；résumé 简历；automatically 自然而然地/自动地；relevance 相关性。
exp.meaning: 看到 who 后先划到从句结束，再找主句谓语；who 从句里又可嵌套 that 宾语从句。
exp.rest: 把 that 从句的谓语 proves 误当成外层谓语，或把其中的 a longer résumé 误当成整句主语，都会错过：Applicants 是主句主语，believe 是 who 从句谓语，overlook 是主句谓语。

nested.target: who 定语从句 / that 宾语从句
nested.skill: who 定语从句 + that 宾语从句 + 主句谓语
nested.q:
Residents who discovered that the shared gate was unlocked called the caretaker.
按“主句主语中心词 / who从句谓语 / 主句谓语”的顺序，哪组正确？
o: Residents / discovered / called
the shared gate / discovered / was
Residents / was unlocked / discovered
the caretaker / called / discovered

exp.trans: 发现公共大门没有锁上的住户给管理员打了电话。
exp.structure: 简单句①Residents called the caretaker. ②Residents discovered something. ③The shared gate was unlocked. → 把③接在discovered后：Residents discovered that the shared gate was unlocked. → 把重复的Residents换成who并嵌入①：Residents [who discovered [that the shared gate was unlocked]] called the caretaker。主句完整主语包含who从句，中心词是Residents。
exp.other: resident 住户；shared 共用的；unlocked 没锁上的；caretaker 管理员。
exp.meaning: 发现这件事的是住户；没有锁上的是大门；打电话给管理员的还是住户。三个小句的主语和谓语不能串层。
exp.rest: the shared gate只在that从句中作主语，不能升为主句主语。was unlocked属于that从句，discovered属于who从句；两者都不是主句谓语。the caretaker是called的宾语，不是发现大门未锁的人。

nested.skill: 区分定语从句、宾语从句和主句谓语
nested.q: Editors who learned that the quote was inaccurate removed it from the draft. Which sequence gives the main-clause subject head / who-clause verb / main-clause verb?
o: Editors / learned / removed
the quote / learned / was
Editors / was / learned
the draft / removed / learned

exp.trans: 得知引文不准确的编辑把它从草稿中删掉了。主句主语中心词是Editors，who从句谓语是learned，主句谓语是removed。
exp.structure: 主句骨架是Editors removed it from the draft；who learned...修饰Editors；that the quote was inaccurate是learned的宾语从句。三个谓语属于不同层级。
exp.other: editor 编辑；quote 引文；inaccurate 不准确的；draft 草稿。
exp.meaning: 先找主句骨架，再把who定语从句和that宾语从句分别嵌入。quote是that从句的主语，Editors才是主句主语。
exp.rest: the quote只在that从句中作主语；was属于that宾语从句，不是who从句谓语；the draft是介词from的宾语，不是主句主语。

nested.target: whatever + 名词 / 嵌入式修饰结构
nested.skill: 名词短语内部结构与主句宾语
nested.q: The workshop lets each visiting researcher retain whatever equipment they brought for the project. Which analysis is accurate?
o: The phrase is the subject of lets and refers to the researcher.
The whole phrase is the object of retain; whatever determines equipment.
The phrase is a direct question asking what equipment was brought.
The phrase modifies workshop and explains why the visit occurred.

exp.trans: 工作坊允许每位来访研究人员保留自己为项目带来的任何设备。whatever equipment they brought for the project整体作retain的宾语。
exp.structure: 主句骨架：The workshop lets each visiting researcher retain something。whatever equipment they brought for the project替换something，整体是retain的宾语；whatever限定equipment，they brought for the project修饰equipment。
exp.other: workshop工作坊；visiting researcher来访研究人员；retain保留；equipment设备。
exp.meaning: whatever + 名词可表示“任何……/所……的任何东西”。先识别整个名词短语在主句中的位置，再分析短语内部的限定词和修饰从句。
exp.rest: 主句主语是The workshop，不是whatever短语；这里不是直接疑问句；whatever短语不修饰workshop，也不说明访问原因。

nested.target: whatever + 名词 / 整体作宾语
nested.skill: 名词性结构与从句内部关系
nested.q: The registrar will accept whatever documents the applicant submits before Friday. What role does the underlined phrase play?
o: It is the object of accept: any documents the applicant submits.
It is the subject of submits and refers to the registrar.
It asks which documents the applicant may submit.
It modifies Friday and explains the reason for the deadline.

exp.trans: 登记员会接受申请人在周五之前提交的任何文件。whatever documents the applicant submits整体作accept的宾语。
exp.structure: 主句：The registrar will accept something。whatever documents the applicant submits before Friday整体替代something，作accept的宾语；the applicant submits是修饰documents的限定性关系结构，documents是submits的宾语。
exp.other: registrar登记员；applicant申请人；submit提交；deadline截止时间。
exp.meaning: whatever + 名词表示任何符合后续限定的该类事物；整个短语可以在主句中作宾语。要区分外层动词accept与内层从句谓语submits。
exp.rest: underlined phrase不是submits的主语，内层主语是the applicant；这不是直接疑问句；Friday是before的宾语，不是被whatever短语修饰的对象，也没有说明截止原因。
